amends.supersedes_only: The V2-A012 fixed-probe input rule. This amendment replaces its image-plus-robot-state probe with an image-only generic policy diagnostic because the pinned implementation cannot return robot-state-conditioned actions and a decoded future in one request.
does_not_supersede: V2-A012 base checkpoint identity, revision, source commits, storage gate, load gate, topology gate, or behavioral lock
V2-A012 six conditional behavioral cells, all of which remain unreleased
The requirement for a separately frozen 10D-to-8D controller before any possible behavior

experiment_identity.reporting_label: Cosmos3-Super base image-only action-and-video interface diagnostic

evidence_files.fact: A generic action_mode request without robot_obs or observation decodes video and returns payload.video plus payload.actions. The robot_obs/observation route bypasses video output and returns metadata.common.action_only_output=true.
policy uses first-frame visual conditioning and allows a policy action sequence when raw_action_dim and action_chunk_size are supplied.
The asynchronous video response schema contains action metadata and a completed video artifact.
The DROID action representation is 10D end-effector pose plus gripper and has a 16-frame action duration.

pinned_source_attestation.interface_decision: Use the generic image-only policy route for the three-request action-and-video diagnostic. Do not send robot_obs, observation, joint state, end-effector state, gripper state, history action, simulator state, or a state surrogate, because the state-bearing route is action-only.

parameter_provenance.reason: V2-A014 reuses the already frozen generic asynchronous action-and-video interface values (17 frames, 16x10 actions, and static image route) without releasing Edge behavior or changing Super's inherited three-request budget.

fixed_rgb.role: same committed Edge diagnostic RGB bytes, reused without modification

robot_state.interpretation: Outputs are image-and-language-conditioned interface evidence only. They cannot support a DROID behavioral, closed-loop, state-conditioned, controller, or execution claim.

requests.prompt: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
requests.byte_identical_to: V2-A014-P00 except request identifier and transport timestamps

requests.prompt: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

required_per_completed_request: full create and final response JSON with exact request-body hash
top-level returned action payload, metadata, dtype, shape, and hash
decoded content MP4 with byte hash and frame-count verification
server/software/environment provenance and immutable checkpoint hash

shape_and_media_checks.action_values: finite only; otherwise retain an interface failure and release no controller
shape_and_media_checks.repeat_requirement: LEFT request, returned action payload, and decoded video must be bit-identical for V2-A014-P00/P01 after excluding server-assigned identifiers/timestamps.
shape_and_media_checks.contrast_requirement: LEFT and RIGHT are retained as contrast evidence only; no success, endpoint, execution, or causality score is inferred.

acceptance_and_retention.missing_or_partial_rule: A missing action, latent-only action, corrupt video, non-decoding video, timeout, load failure, or partial response is preserved as interface or infrastructure evidence. It is never coerced to zero and never enters a behavioral denominator.

hard_prohibitions: No simulator launch, reset, action, controller, CuRobo call, or viewport video is authorized by this amendment.
No DROID execution, success rate, endpoint score, or behavioral denominator is authorized.
No robot state may be added to recover a state-conditioned result while retaining a future-video claim.
No Nano, Edge, or other checkpoint may substitute for Cosmos3-Super base.
No request may exceed the inherited total of three V2-A012/A014 fixed interface requests.

claim_boundary.current_status: No Cosmos3-Super inference, model-generated video, action output, simulator rollout, or success claim exists at amendment creation.
claim_boundary.allowed_future_wording: If gates pass, report only image-only action-and-video interface evidence under V2-A014.
disallowed_future_wording: world-model prediction conditioned on robot state
